item.title: Use Lightning and Hydra to train your neural networks
item.description: Deep learning research is moving at an incredible pace, and so are the tools that support rapid experimentation. In this post, we’ll explore how to combine PyTorch Lightning and Hydra to streamline the training of a deep neural network—in our case, a Llama model trained on protein sequences, which will allow for protein sequence generation via next amino acid prediction. We’ll also integrate components from Hugging Face to leverage state-of-the-art language model architectures.
